title: Horizon New Dawn parity baseline
brief:
In nckrtl/horizon-new-dawn, create horizon-sync.json before running upstream detection.

Choose the latest stable laravel/horizon tag whose implemented surface passes compatibility tests. Record synced_tag and covered rows with kind, upstream and covered_by for routes, public controller actions, screens and config keys actually implemented by New Dawn. Do not claim missing features.

Run composer test:compatibility against that exact tag and composer format:test && composer analyse && composer test. Add ledger validation tests.

Leave scripts/horizon-sync in place. Publish a pull request and wait for Nick. Do not detect or start release tasks until the baseline is merged. Never merge.

Swamp candidate: horizon-sync:baseline

deliverables.description: Horizon compatibility tests pass against the selected upstream tag
Project checks pass after the parity change
deliverables.command: composer format:test && composer analyse && composer test
